name: Fable 5.1 Oracle
author: Matt Rice
summary: Uses Claude Code to plan repository work and review results, producing handoff packets for a separate coding agent.
starterPrompt: Review this repository task and return a planning packet with constraints, acceptance criteria, and proof to collect. Do not edit files or launch another agent.
usageNote: Requires a compatible Claude Code setup and subscription. Check the requested model and repository permissions; review every handoff before running an implementation.
